Package com.trevlar.menukit.containers.api.slot

package com.trevlar.menukit.containers.api.slot
  • Class
    Description
    ClientContainerPanel
    The client half of a ContainerPanel: what only the client has, declared from the client initializer.
    ClientSlots
    The client half of CreatedSlots.onto(AbstractContainerMenu, Player): showing a registered slot group on screen.
    ContainerKeys
    The server-tier behaviour key that Containers itself enforces.
    ContainerPanel
    Registers, in one call and with no mixin, a panel whose slots have container parity: they appear, take clicks and sync on every screen that shows the player inventory (survival, creative, and every chest, furnace or modded container).
    ContainerPanel.Builder
    Configures the panel.
    CreatedSlot
    A slot that is a vanilla Slot to everything outside it.
    CreatedSlots
    Adds real, server-synced, persistent slots to a vanilla menu.
    CreatedSlots.Builder
    Configures one group of slots.
    CreatedSlots.RegisteredSlots
    What register() created: the MenuPanel and SlotGroup, plus the slot-index range appended to the menu, for consumers that walk the slots directly.
    DropRule
    What happens to a player-scoped slot's content on death, set per attachment.
    MendingCandidates
    Lets a consumer add extra items to the XP repair pool, beyond the registered slots opted in by address through ContainerKeys.MENDING.
    MendingCandidates.Candidate
    One mendable item plus how to persist its repair.
    MendingCandidates.Provider
    Supplies a player's extra mend candidates when an XP orb is collected.
    SlotElement
    A registered slot shown as a PanelElement.
    SlotElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotElement.
    SlotFlowElement
    Lays out a panel's registered slots to fit its width, the way text and elements size to fit.
    SlotFlowElement.Builder
    Builds a SlotFlowElement over slot elements, in flow order.
    SlotGroup
    A group of slots: their Storage, shift-click priority, right-click handler and layout.
    SlotSpec
    A side-neutral description of one group of registered slots that a ContainerPanel adds to every container the player opens.
